description: Collect any public X profile and its posts without login, cookies or API keys.

activeWithinDays.description: Optional. Skip accounts whose newest public post is older than this many days. 0 means any. Requires reading the latest posts to evaluate.
activeWithinDays.title: Active within days

bioKeywords.description: Optional. Keep only accounts whose name or bio contains every keyword (case-insensitive).
bioKeywords.title: Bio keywords

dateFrom.description: Optional. Only keep posts published on or after this date.
dateFrom.title: Posted after

dateTo.description: Optional. Only keep posts published on or before this date.
dateTo.title: Posted before

enrichEngagement.description: Refresh each collected post through its public status page for views, bookmarks and complete media. Adds one request per post. Turn off for the cheapest profile-only runs.
enrichEngagement.title: Enrich engagement per post

include.description: Pick one or more data groups. Everything works without cookies. `topPosts` is engagement-ranked from the candidate pool (X serves no public Top tab to guests). `replies` and `highlights` are best-effort: X sometimes refuses those guest timelines.
include.title: What to collect

includeHighlights.description: Also collect the account's curated Highlights tab. The guest legacy userId query pages the whole set through its bottom cursor (observed 100-1,097 rows on large accounts); the live one-page query remains a fallback.
includeHighlights.title: Include Highlights tab

includeReplies.description: Keep replies the account sent. Best effort: X only serves the reply timeline to logged-out callers on some attempts.
includeReplies.title: Include replies

includeRetweets.description: Keep reposts in the results. Turn off to get only posts the account wrote itself.
includeRetweets.title: Include reposts

language.description: Optional. Keep only posts detected in this language, e.g. `en`, `es`, `ja`. Locale forms such as `en-US` or `pt-BR` are normalized to their two-letter code in code, so old tasks keep working.
language.title: Post language

maxFollowers.description: Optional. Skip accounts above this follower count. 0 means any.
maxFollowers.title: Maximum followers

maxPostsPerProfile.description: Target number of posts per account (1-1000). The actor follows X's guest timeline bottom cursor back to X's ceiling of about 3,200 posts; guest search top-ups are best effort. Filter-heavy runs page until the target number of matching rows is found or the source ceiling is reached. A pinned post can be added beyond this cap when it passes your filters; it stays in chronological order for latest and in ranked order for top.
maxPostsPerProfile.title: Maximum posts per profile

mediaType.description: Optional. Keep only posts with this media type. `media` in What to collect already limits rows to media posts.
mediaType.title: Media type

minAccountAgeDays.description: Optional. Skip accounts younger than this. 0 means any. Accounts without a public join date are skipped when this is set.
minAccountAgeDays.title: Minimum account age (days)

minFollowers.description: Optional. Skip accounts below this follower count. 0 means any.
minFollowers.title: Minimum followers

minimumLikes.description: Optional. Drop posts with fewer likes than this.
minimumLikes.title: Minimum likes

minimumQuotes.description: Optional. Drop posts with fewer quotes than this. Posts whose quote count X does not expose are dropped when this is set.
minimumQuotes.title: Minimum quotes

minimumReplies.description: Optional. Drop posts with fewer replies than this.
minimumReplies.title: Minimum replies

minimumRetweets.description: Optional. Drop posts with fewer reposts than this.
minimumRetweets.title: Minimum reposts

minimumViews.description: Optional. Drop posts with fewer views than this. Posts whose view count X does not expose are dropped when this is set.
minimumViews.title: Minimum views

onlyVerified.description: Skip accounts that do not carry a verified badge.
onlyVerified.title: Only verified accounts

onlyWithMedia.description: Keep only posts that contain media.
onlyWithMedia.title: Only posts with images, videos or GIFs

postUrls.description: Optional. Collect these exact posts (focal post plus up to 3 replies each) in addition to the profiles above. Accepts `https://x.com/user/status/123` or a numeric post id.
postUrls.title: Specific post URLs or ids

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor works without a proxy and tries a direct connection first. Use this only if you want to override the built-in direct -> Apify AUTO escalation.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Optional extras. The actor works fully without these.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

usernames.description: Accounts to collect. Paste handles like `elonmusk`, `@apify`, profile links like `https://x.com/elonmusk`, numeric ids like `11348282` or `id:11348282`. Handles, links and ids can be mixed.
usernames.title: X usernames, profile links or numeric ids

verifiedType.description: Optional. Keep only accounts with this verification type. X and FxTwitter labels are normalized in code.
verifiedType.title: Verification type

withWebsiteOnly.description: Skip accounts that expose no website link in their profile or bio.
withWebsiteOnly.title: Only accounts with a website

title: X (Twitter) Profile & Post Engagement Extractor
